criteria.title: Preserve question-specific authority
criteria.model: Shipped agent guidance assigns each question class to exactly one authority (graph: topology; LSP: compiler semantics; rg: current text; ast-grep: syntax), never routes a semantic or current-text question to the graph, and confines packers to post-retrieval use on an explicit include set.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) shipped guidance names the graph as authority for a compiler-semantic or current-text question; (2) guidance.integration.test.ts 'publishes local guidance through actual tools/list and refuses raw query without another child' is red or absent; (3) its mutation case 'the same discovery oracle rejects an isolated forbidden-next-route mutation' is red or absent; (4) Serena appears in any guidance route; (5) existing guidance overrides or code:run access are forked instead of reused; (6) a packer (repomix or code2prompt) can run without an explicit include set or off its pinned version, i.e. it is usable as a retrieval step instead of post-retrieval: packer-facade.test.ts 'both builders refuse an empty include set', 'the facade turns that into a refusal ANSWER, not a thrown error' or 'accepts exactly the pinned repomix version' is red or absent. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read the testing:runs rows (source=ci, worktreeDirty=false, committed candidate) for guidance.integration.test.ts and runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts, then capability:read packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/graph-fallback-guidance.ts and libs/papercusp/plugins/gitnexus-bridge/index.ts guidance text. Cite the it() titles in marker (2) and (3) by name. index.test.ts is deliberately NOT bound: its 64 tests pin plugin surface (PATH fallbacks), not authority. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement); this bar constrains how agents consume it, not which engine. Packers are post-retrieval tools: packer-facade.test.ts is the binding row for marker (6). PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Actionable, truthful guidance
criteria.model: Shipped guidance fires on known-symbol and shared-helper-change questions, shows the fallback matching the failure class, and never promises complete consumers or exact current source.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) guidance sends agents to a refused raw query path (guidance.integration.test.ts 'publishes local guidance through actual tools/list and refuses raw query without another child' red or absent); (2) guidance promises every consumer or exact current source; (3) the fallback shown does not match the failure class; (4) runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts 'is up to date with index.ts (regenerate with: npm run gen:gitnexus-bridge)' is red, i.e. source and generated artifact drifted; (5) 'ships the agent-facing tool guidance that the hand-written mirror omitted' is red; (6) the known-symbol or shared-helper-change trigger text is absent from the shipped guidance. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read the testing:runs rows for guidance.integration.test.ts and runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts at the committed candidate, then compare the shipped guidance text (capability:read libs/papercusp/plugins/gitnexus-bridge/index.ts) with the generated runtime artifact. index.test.ts is deliberately NOT bound (plugin-surface tests). GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement). PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Truthful failure and coverage
criteria.model: The code-intelligence contract reports source coverage only against a measured denominator, never collapses distinct result states (graph edge, file-level link, limited output, stale revision, missing/unindexed symbol, backend failure) into one another, and never presents a degraded LSP result as exhaustive references.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) contracts.ts collapses two of the six states (graph edge, file-level link, limited output, stale revision, missing/unindexed symbol, backend failure) into one; (2) an empty, non-truncated, fresh result claims source coverage without a measured denominator; (3) graph-coverage.integration.test.ts 'propagates a fresh-index miss without turning it into source absence' or 'reports ambiguity and backend failure distinctly across the handler' is red or absent; (4) contracts.test.ts 'grades an unmeasured backend not-measured, NOT within-budget' or 'grades a TRUNCATED walk not-measured even when the partial total looks fine' is red or absent; (5) an LSP degraded result is presented as exhaustive references: lsp-facade-coverage.test.ts 'labels degraded same-file references as potentially missing external consumers' is red or absent; (6) a repair for a named failure was chosen without first diagnosing it against current code and the exact indexed revision: consumer-evidence.integration.test.ts 'NEGATIVE: a stale index is bound to its OWN revision, so the mismatch is visible' is red or absent, or the repair work-item names no read of current code. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read testing:runs rows for graph-coverage.integration.test.ts, lsp-facade-coverage.test.ts and contracts.test.ts at the committed candidate, and capability:read packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/contracts.ts to confirm the six states are distinct types or fields. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement). Markers (5)-(6) restore the rev3 clauses 'LSP degraded results must not silently become exhaustive references' and 'diagnose named failures against current code and exact indexed revisions before choosing repairs'. PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) consumer-evidence.test.ts 'a graph INVOCATION with no consumers and no independent sweep is not evidence' or 'ZERO callers from the graph alone (graph-empty) is not evidence of absence' is red or absent; (2) consumer-evidence.integration.test.ts 'NEGATIVE: a stale index is bound to its OWN revision, so the mismatch is visible' or 'NEGATIVE: a backend that throws falls back, and unchecked behavior keeps the outcome nonpassing' is red or absent; (3) a consumer list is presented without its index revision and unchecked set; (4) a new rubric/BAR scorer exists parallel to the existing acceptance method; (5) a mandatory failure or unknown leaves a passing rating; (6) resolved consumers are not individually source-corroborated: consumer-evidence.test.ts 'one uncorroborated consumer among corroborated ones still leaves the set unverified' or 'with the graph never invoked and nothing else, consumers are simply unresolved' is red or absent; (7) the index revision is not compared as a revision: consumer-evidence.test.ts 'a prefix of the same commit is the same revision; a different commit is not' is red or absent; (8) a consumer claim is accepted without the evidence/tests behind it, i.e. an acceptance rating cites no testing:runs row for the two consumer-evidence files. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

criteria.model: The bounded engine comparison ran baseline LSP/rg, installed GitNexus, one pinned candidate GitNexus and Codebase-Memory on the same frozen scheduler/fingerprint/consumer/route/symbol cases plus the edit, delete and refresh-failure fixtures, reported per engine correct conclusions, missed consumers, response size, cold and warm timing, resource and index cost, disclosed every fairness gap, and bound each report to its engine build; CodeGraphContext and SCIP are not default installs.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) any of the four engines is missing from docs/evidence/gitnexus-engine-comparison-2026-10-01/ (report-baseline-lsp-rg.json, report-gitnexus-installed.json, report-gitnexus-candidate.json, report-codebase-memory.json); (2) fairness-audit.json is absent, or any of its criteria is FAIL, or its allClear:false is not disclosed in engine-comparison.md '## Disclosures' (the audit is allClear:false: C1 and C10 PASS, C3/C6/C8 WARN, C2/C4/C5/C7/C9 NEEDS-EVIDENCE, no FAIL); (3) an engine was measured on different tasks than the others (task-runs.json); (4) a report is not bound to its engine build: engine-comparison-provenance.integration.test.ts 'reproduces the recorded verdict, residue and source-parity reading' or 're-pointing one executed arm at a different tree is reported as a fingerprint mismatch' is red or absent; (5) an unexecuted arm is counted as a pass ('an arm that was never executed is UNAVAILABLE residue and the verdict cannot be a pass' red or absent); (6) the frozen task set differs between arms: task-runs.json lacks any of selective-scheduler-edge, selective-fingerprint-chain, selective-external-consumer, selective-route-boundary or selective-exact-index-symbol for any of the four arms, or an arm ran with a different seed, modelId or preregHash; (7) the update fixtures are missing or unfrozen: engine-comparison.md '## Update fixtures' lacks edit, delete or refresh-failure for any arm, or selective-corpus.test.ts 'carries dirty-state, disambiguation, reexport and recovery counterexamples' is red or absent (frozen ambiguity, re-export, dirty edit/delete and refresh-failure fixtures); (8) arms are not comparable on source, model or account without disclosure: verdict.json sourceParity.same is false and engine-comparison.md '## Source parity' does not name the mismatching arm, or a task-runs.json row has a modelId that differs from the others (all rows are tool-level, modelId 'none-tool-only', ZERO LLM tokens, per '## Disclosures');
